hr.calendarHint: Select a day to see its details; select it again to show the whole month.
hr.noContract: You do not have an active employment contract yet, so clock-in and requests are not available. Ask HR to add your contract.
hr.noContractMonth: No active contract, so there is no attendance sheet.
hr.pattern.noDays: Choose at least one working day.
hr.pattern.endBeforeStart: The shift must end after it starts (same day).
hr.pattern.breakHint: E.g. 09:00–21:00 with 13:00–17:00 off. The break is not paid and does not count as lateness.
hr.pattern.breakBoth: Enter both the break start and end, or untick the break.
hr.pattern.breakInside: The break must start after the shift starts and end before it ends.
hr.loc.okNetworkTitle: Clocked from the clinic’s internet connection.
hr.loc.okGpsTitle: The phone’s position was {{m}} m from the clinic (accuracy {{a}} m).
hr.loc.outsideTitle: The phone’s position was outside the radius around the clinic.
hr.loc.unverifiedTitle: Not on a listed clinic network and no phone position was sent.
hr.loc.unverifiedGpsTitle: A phone position was sent, but this clinic has no radius or map location to compare it with.
hr.me.subtitle: Clock in and out, see your month and balance, and request leave or permissions.
hr.todayRest: Today is a rest day for you. Time worked today counts as rest-day overtime.
hr.clockInAgainHint: When you are back from the break or from stepping out, clock in again. Time out without a permission counts as lateness.
hr.clockHint: The server records the time (Cairo time). For a shift that ends after midnight, clock out as usual: it closes the previous day.
hr.openSinceYesterday: You clocked in yesterday at {{time}} and have not clocked out yet. Clock out to close that shift.
hr.locRefusedConsole: The console can only recognise the clinic’s internet connection; it never uses your location.
hr.balance.title: Leave balance
hr.balance.breakdown: Entitled {{entitled}} + carried over {{carried}} + adjustment {{adjusted}} − taken {{used}} − requested {{pending}}
hr.balance.poolHint: Annual and casual leave share this balance.
hr.balance.noContract: No contract, so no leave entitlement this year.
hr.balance.range: Carry-over must be 0–90 days and the adjustment between −90 and 90.
hr.leave.daysHint: Only your working days are counted; rest days and public holidays are not (maternity and Hajj leave count calendar days).
hr.leave.endBeforeStart: The last day is before the first day.
hr.leave.pvLeft: {{n}} day(s) left in your balance after this request.
hr.leave.pvQuotaLeft: {{n}} of the {{quota}} days a year for this type left after it.
hr.leave.pvOverBalance: This needs {{n}} day(s) but only {{available}} are available in your balance.
hr.leave.pvOverQuota: This is more than the yearly limit of {{quota}} days for this leave type ({{left}} left).
hr.leave.pvOverMax: This leave type allows at most {{max}} consecutive days.
hr.leave.pvWillRefuse: The request would be refused. Change the dates or the leave type.
hr.perm.hint: An approved permission excuses that time from lateness and early leaving, including stepping out during the day. There is a monthly limit on the number and minutes of permissions.
hr.perm.endBeforeStart: The end time must be after the start time.
hr.perm.left: Left this month: {{n}} of {{of}} permissions, {{d}} of {{ofD}}.
hr.perm.noneLeft: Your permission allowance for this month is used up, so a new request will be refused.
hr.perm.noneLeftIn: Your permission allowance for {{month}} is used up, so a new request for that month will be refused.
hr.perm.otherMonth: Requests for another month count against that month's allowance.
hr.req.cancelConfirm: The request will be withdrawn. An approved request can only be cancelled before it starts.
hr.team.subtitle: Who is in today, each person's month, corrections and overtime approval.
hr.correctHint: Times are Cairo local time. Remove every pair to mark the day without attendance. A correction resets the overtime approval.
hr.punch.title: {{n}} clock-in/out pairs
hr.punch.correctHint: One pair per stretch of work, in order (e.g. before and after the break). Only the last clock-out may be left empty. A time earlier than the one before it is the next day.
hr.punch.maxReached: The most clock-ins for one day ({{n}}) are recorded.
hr.outNextDayHint: Earlier than the clock-in means the next day.
hr.otToPendingHint: Clears the decision: the overtime waits for a decision again and is not paid until approved.
hr.otRejectedToast: Overtime rejected; it will not be paid
hr.appr.subtitle: Approve or reject pending requests. Nobody can decide their own request.
hr.appr.own: Your own request: another manager decides
hr.staff.subtitle: Employment contracts, working patterns and leave balances.
hr.contract.title: Employment contract
hr.contract.endDateHint: For a fixed-term contract. To end employment now, use “End employment”.
hr.contract.noneHint: No active contract. Without one, this person cannot clock in, request leave or be paid.
hr.contract.payHidden: Salary, insurance and bank details are visible only with the payroll view privilege.
hr.contract.dobHint: Used for the 30-day annual leave from age 50.
hr.contract.commissionHint: Commission-only staff are paid their approved doctor commission; leave empty for no fixed amount.
hr.contract.insuredHint: Contributions are calculated on the declared insurable wage within the yearly limits.
hr.contract.ibanHint: EG followed by 27 digits. After saving, only the last 4 digits are shown.
hr.contract.ibanKeep: An IBAN ending in {{last4}} is on file. Leave empty to keep it.
hr.contract.ibanInvalid: An Egyptian IBAN is EG followed by 27 digits.
hr.contract.endHint: The contract stays in the history; payroll stops after this date.
hr.contract.payUnusedLeave: Pay unused annual leave in the final month
hr.contract.payUnusedLeaveHint: Days earned up to the end date (plus carry-over and adjustments, less leave taken) × the daily rate, added as a taxable adjustment to that month's payroll. Monthly salaries only.
hr.contract.endNegativeHint: A negative balance (more leave taken than earned) is not deducted automatically; add a deduction yourself if needed.
hr.contract.endNotPaid: {{days}} unused; nothing was added to payroll.
hr.contract.endNegative: The balance is negative (more leave taken than earned). Nothing was deducted automatically; add a payroll deduction if needed.
hr.allow.title: Allowances (monthly)
hr.allow.name: Allowance
hr.allow.nameRequired: Enter the Arabic name of the allowance.
hr.allow.duplicateCode: Two allowances have the same name. Give each a different English name.
hr.loc.title: Clock-in location
hr.loc.intro: Each clinic can check that staff are really at the clinic when they clock in or out. Only the result is kept (verified, outside or not verified), never the address or position.
hr.loc.introNetwork: Network means the clinic’s internet connection: its public IP address range. The clinic’s IT person or internet provider can give it to you. Staff clocking from the clinic’s Wi-Fi or cable are verified; mobile data is not.
hr.loc.introRadius: Radius means a distance around the clinic. It works only from the mobile app once GPS support is added; the console never uses location.
hr.loc.introFlag: Flag accepts every clock-in and records a warning for managers when it cannot be verified.
hr.loc.introBlock: Block refuses clocking that cannot be verified; the person then asks a manager to record their attendance.
hr.loc.recommend: Start with Flag for a few weeks and look at the badges on Team attendance. Switch to Block only when the network list is complete.
hr.loc.modeHint.flag: Clocking is always accepted; when it cannot be verified, managers see a warning on the attendance board.
hr.loc.modeHint.block: Clocking that cannot be verified is refused. The person must ask a manager to record their attendance.
hr.loc.networksHint: One range per line, for example 197.32.10.0/24. A single address is saved as a range of one address. Ask the clinic’s IT person or internet provider for the clinic’s public IP range. Up to 20.
hr.loc.radiusHint: Works only from the mobile app once GPS support is added. 25 to 2000 m; leave empty for no radius.
hr.loc.noClinicLocation: This clinic has no map location yet, so a radius cannot be used. Enter its latitude and longitude on the clinics admin page.
hr.loc.blockRadiusOnly: With Block and only a radius, everyone will be refused for now: neither the console nor the app sends a position yet. Add the clinic network or use Flag.
hr.loc.blockWarn: With Block, anyone clocking from outside the listed networks (for example on mobile data) is refused and needs a manager to record their attendance.
hr.loc.readOnly: You can view these rules; changing them needs the HR edit privilege.
hr.set.legalNote: These are legal figures (labour, social insurance and income tax law). Confirm every figure with your accountant before the first payroll, and update the social-insurance minimum and maximum insurable wage each January when the new limits are published.
hr.set.readOnly: You can view these settings; saving needs the settings edit privilege.
hr.set.graceHint: Lateness within this period at the first arrival of the day is ignored.
hr.set.daysPerMonth: Days per month for the daily rate
hr.set.daysPerMonthHint: Daily rate = monthly salary ÷ this number (usual practice: 30).
hr.set.deductLateness: Deduct unexcused lateness and early leaving from pay
hr.set.deductLatenessHint: At the hourly rate derived from the salary. Lateness is every scheduled minute outside the break that is neither clocked in nor covered by a permission: arriving late, stepping out without a permission and returning late from the break.
hr.set.nightHint: Overtime minutes that fall between the night start and end are paid at the night multiplier instead of the normal overtime multiplier, as a separate payslip line. Rest days and holidays keep their own multiplier.
hr.set.nightEndHint: Earlier than the start means the next morning (e.g. 19:00 to 07:00).
hr.set.siYearHint: Payroll warns when a month is in a later year.
hr.set.siOutdated: The social-insurance limits are for {{year}} but it is now {{now}}. Enter this year’s limits and set the year.
hr.set.maxBelowMin: The maximum is below the minimum.
hr.set.exemptionHint: Subtracted from annual taxable income before the brackets.
hr.set.bracketsHint: On annual taxable income after the exemption (EGP). The last bracket has no upper limit.
hr.set.bracketsAscending: Each bracket limit must be above zero and higher than the one before.
hr.set.resetConfirm: Every figure on this page (grace period, permissions, overtime, social insurance and income tax) returns to the built-in defaults. Payroll runs already calculated keep their figures until recalculated. Public holidays and leave types are not affected.
hr.set.storedHint: Only figures that differ from the defaults are stored, so later corrections to the defaults still apply to the rest.
hr.set.holidaysHint: Public holidays are not working days: they do not use leave and do not count as absence. Work on a holiday is paid at the rest-day multiplier.
hr.set.holidaySameDay: Adding a date that already exists renames that holiday.
hr.set.deleteHolidayConfirm: Delete {{name}} ({{d}})? That day becomes a normal working day.
hr.set.leaveTypesHint: Annual and casual leave share the annual balance. Quotas and limits are in days.
pay.subtitle: Prepare, check and approve the monthly payroll. Another person approves what you prepare.
pay.createHint: Calculates a draft payslip for everyone with a contract in force during the month, from attendance, approved overtime and leave, adjustments and approved commission.
pay.draftHint: Draft: recalculate after correcting attendance, approving overtime or adding adjustments. Payslips are visible to staff only after approval.
pay.frozenHint: Approved runs are frozen. Corrections go into next month as adjustments.
pay.fourEyesHint: You prepared this run, so someone else with approval rights must approve it.
pay.recalcConfirm: All payslips in this draft are rebuilt from the latest attendance, leave, adjustments and settings.
pay.approveConfirm: Approving freezes the {{month}} payroll and its adjustments, and makes the payslips visible to staff.
pay.paidConfirm: Confirm that the salaries have been transferred.
pay.downloadsHint: The bank file contains full account numbers. Every download is audited; keep the file safe.
pay.warn.social_insurance_limits_outdate: The social-insurance minimum and maximum wage in HR settings are for an earlier year than this payroll. Update them in HR settings, then recalculate.
pay.warn.period_not_finished: The month is not over yet: days still ahead are not counted as absence or attendance. Recalculate after the month ends.
pay.warn.unapproved_overtime: Some overtime is still awaiting a decision, so it is not paid. Approve or reject it in Team attendance, then recalculate.
pay.warn.insurable_wage_capped: The declared insurable wage is above the legal maximum, so contributions were calculated on the maximum.
pay.warn.insurable_wage_below_minimum: The declared insurable wage is below the legal minimum, so contributions were calculated on the minimum.
pay.warn.high_income_tax_review: Annual taxable income is above EGP 600,000, where special tax rules may apply. Ask the accountant to review this payslip.
pay.warn.negative_net_pay: Deductions are larger than pay, so the net is negative. Review absences, advances and deductions before approving.
pay.adj.title: Adjustments · {{month}}
pay.adj.closed: This month is approved; its adjustments are locked.
pay.adj.taxableHint: For additions: counted in taxable income. For a deduction: taken before tax.
pay.adj.noteRequired: Enter a note of at least 2 characters.
pay.adj.peopleError: The list of people could not be loaded.
pay.adj.recalcHint: Recalculate the draft run afterwards so payslips include it.
pay.adjHint.allowance: A one-off allowance for this month; taxable.
pay.adjHint.overtime: A fixed overtime amount in addition to attendance overtime.
pay.adjHint.reimbursement: Paid after tax; not part of taxable income.
pay.adjHint.deduction: Reduces pay (before tax when taxable is ticked).
pay.adjHint.advance: An advance paid with this salary; recover it later with advance repayments.
pay.adjHint.advance_repayment: Deducted after tax to recover an earlier advance.
pay.adjHint.leave_encashment: Pays out unused annual leave days (added automatically when employment ends); taxable.
pay.my.subtitle: Your payslips from approved payroll months.
pay.my.none: No payslips yet. They appear here once a month’s payroll is approved.
